description: Java class 'MultiRecordExampleAgent' extending BackupAgent, implementing backup and restore logic for application data with multiple records, including handling of individual data fields and their backup states.

classes.name: MultiRecordExampleAgent
classes.description: A BackupAgent subclass that manages backup and restore of application data with multiple individual records, each identified by a key, allowing independent updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the data file location for the backup agent.

methods.name: onBackup
methods.description: Performs backup of individual data fields if they have changed since last backup.

methods.name: writeStateFile
methods.description: Writes the current data state to the backup state file.

methods.name: writeBackupEntity
methods.description: Helper method to write a data entity with a specific key.

methods.name: onRestore
methods.description: Restores data from backup, reconstructing the application's data file.
